questions.q: Identify the correct spelling of the misspelled word.
questions.solution:
The correct spelling is government. Retain the n before ment.

**Answer: government**

questions.q: Identify the correct spelling of the misspelled word.
questions.solution:
Unforeseen means not anticipated. It is spelled un-fore-seen.

**Answer: unforeseen**

questions.q:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She didn't want to talk about it, but he kept,_______ the topic.
questions.solution:
Bringing up a topic means mentioning it in conversation. This fits repeatedly returning to the topic.

**Answer: bringing up**

questions.q: Choose the correct synonym for the word 'absolve'
questions.solution:
Absolve means free someone from blame or guilt. Pardon is the matching listed word.

**Answer: Pardon**

questions.q:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

You ought to respect elders
options: Elders ought to be respected by you
Elders should be respected by you
Elders ought to be respected by me
questions.solution:
Keep the modal expression ought to and add be + past participle: Elders ought to be respected by you.

**Answer: Elders ought to be respected by you**

questions.q:
Select the correct Passive form of the given sentence

Will you teach chess to my daughter?
options: Will my daughter be taught chess?
Could my daughter be taught chess?
Can my daughter be taught chess?
Would my daughter be taught chess?
questions.solution:
Make my daughter the passive subject and retain will: Will my daughter be taught chess?

**Answer: Will my daughter be taught chess?**

questions.q: Someone who enjoys being around people, sociable and outgoing is called?
questions.solution:
Gregarious describes a sociable person who enjoys company.

**Answer: Gregarious**

questions.q: Someone who is unable to read or write is referred to as...
questions.solution:
An illiterate person cannot read or write. Literate means able to do so.

**Answer: Illiterate**

questions.q: Choose the word that means the same as "Magnificence".
questions.solution:
Magnificence means impressive splendour. Grandeur has the same meaning.

**Answer: Grandeur**

questions.q: Choose the word that means the same as "Flattery".
questions.solution:
Adulation is excessive praise or flattery.

**Answer: Adulation**

questions.q: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word "Denial".
questions.solution:
Denial rejects or refuses to accept something. Affirmation accepts or confirms it.

**Answer: Affirmation**

questions.q: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word "Differ".
questions.solution:
To differ is to be unlike or disagree. To conform is to agree or fit the same pattern.

**Answer: Conform**

questions.q: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word "Clear".
questions.solution:
Clear means easy to perceive or understand. Obscure means unclear and is the opposite.

**Answer: Obscure**

questions.q: Which sentence correctly uses confirm?
options: Please confirm your attendance before Friday.
They conform the package before delivery.
He couldn't confirm to the crowd's pressure.
She confirmed with the regulations strictly
questions.solution:
Confirm your attendance means state definitely that you will attend. Conform means comply and fits different contexts.

**Answer: Please confirm your attendance before Friday.**

questions.q: What is the meaning of "kind" in: "That was a very kind gesture."
questions.solution:
In kind gesture, kind means considerate or caring, rather than a category or type.

**Answer: Friendly or caring**

questions.q: In the following, there are four different words, out of which only one word is correctly spelt. Find the correctly spelt word.
questions.solution:
Desperation is correctly spelled. The other options should read depression, jubilation and fascination.

**Answer: Desperation**

questions.q: In the following, there are four different words, out of which only one word is correctly spelt. Find the correctly spelt word.
questions.solution:
Flimsy is correctly spelled. The other words should be funny, irrational and partisan.

**Answer: Flimsy**

questions.q: Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. In my entire life(A)/one of the best gift (B)/ I have received (C)/ is the car(D).
questions.solution:
After one of the, use a plural noun: one of the best gifts. Segment B contains the error.

**Answer: one of the best gift (B)**

questions.q: Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. Rahul is(A) / taller(B) / than any boy(C)/ in his office(D).
questions.solution:
The comparison includes Rahul, so use any other boy to avoid comparing him with himself. Segment C contains the error.

**Answer: than any boy (C)**

questions.q:
Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. 

God did not (A)/create any(B)/ form in life (C)/without a purpose(D).
questions.solution:
The intended phrase is form of life, not form in life. Segment C contains the error.

**Answer: form in life (C)**

questions.q: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks: He went home and excitedly -------- his mother the story.
questions.solution:
The past-tense verb told matches went. The sentence reads: excitedly told his mother the story.

**Answer: told**
